title: Hex dump
description:
Write `class Hex` with `static String dump(byte[] data)` that formats bytes the way hex viewers do, 8 per line:

```
00000000  48 65 6c 6c 6f 2c 20 4a  Hello, J
00000008  61 76 61 21 0a           ava!.
```

- Each line starts with the offset as 8 hex digits, then two spaces.
- Then each byte as two lower-case hex digits followed by a space, padded with spaces so the text column always starts at the same place (a full line of 8 bytes takes 24 characters).
- Then one more space and the bytes as characters: printable ASCII (32–126) as itself, anything else as `.`.
- Lines are joined with `"\n"`; no data gives `""`.
hints: `data[i] & 0xFF` turns the signed byte into 0–255 before formatting; otherwise `0xff` would print as `ffffffff`.
`String.format("%-24s", hex)` pads the hex part with spaces to 24 characters, so short last lines still line up.
